metrics.provenance: New full-cohort nonlinear solves at the retained amplitude.

isolatedInputInformation.protocol: One channel alone or all channels off; declared probabilities; deterministic saved response per input.
isolatedInputInformation.interpretation: Not bits/second, physical communication capacity, a noise-robust estimate, or evidence that simultaneous input combinations superpose.

limitations: Import checks data structure; it does not rerun or certify the source calculation.
Coverage is conditional on the channels and amplitudes actually tested, not a population-wide design yield.
Exact real-valued rank describes a binary table; it is not a proof of independently commandable patterns for nonlinear neurons.
Lost-with-block is intervention dependence, not proof of the anatomical origin of depolarization.
No original-host preservation or restoration is inferred from introduced-cell recruitment.
metrics.headlineMeaning: Conditional on the nominal finite-shell light field; the three exposure probes agree. This is not a rigorous uncertainty-certified firing result.
